g.title: flashserver_scheduler_flow
g.text: max_loaded=0 means no slot limit; admission is driven by runtime cells, free VRAM and CPU policy

g.title: acquire
g.text: Inspect + Inventory outside the lock on every loop

g.title: place
g.text: runtime cell: SM + CUDA + Python ABI
free VRAM per GPU ≥ min_vram_mib + headroom
satisfies gpu_count; legacy bundles use a 6144MiB floor
VRAM of starting residents is reserved first

g.title: evict
g.text: wait 300ms for the driver to release VRAM

g.title: cpu
g.text: requires a CPU runtime cell; checks free RAM when min_ram_mib is declared

g.title: plan_ok
g.text: no manifest (legacy/test) leaves the device unconstrained

g.title: queue
g.text: only for resource_exhausted with an active resident

g.title: start
g.text: a client timeout does not cancel loading

g.title: race
g.text: unload the new process; wake both waiters

g.title: failed
g.text: OOM without min_vram → hint to declare it

g.title: release
g.text: only affects the same resident generation

g.title: reconcile
g.text: Manager reports a dead process → drop the resident
the next request starts fresh instead of reusing a dead endpoint

g.title: force
g.text: zero leases; active requests are treated as cancelled
